sloka: तमुवाचाथ सुग्रीवस्सप्त सालानिमान्पुरा ।एवमेकैकशो वाली विव्याथाथ स चासकृत् ॥४-११-७०॥।।
transliteration: tamuvācātha sugrīvassapta sālānimānpurā ।evamekaikaśo vālī vivyāthātha sa cāsakṛt ॥4-11-70॥।।

translations.english: Then Sugriva told Lakshmana that earlier Vali had split through these seven Sala trees one after the other, several times.
